# Colver Systems

> The Future of Digital Creation. High-performance digital platforms, intelligent workflows, and modern web engineering.

Colver (https://colver.in) engineers custom software systems, scalable web applications, modern digital commerce platforms, multi-godown operations platforms, and AI-driven workflow automations.

## Core Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://colver.in/services): Enterprise backend APIs, microservices, cloud edge architectures, and scalable full-stack applications.
- [Web Application Development](https://colver.in/services): Sub-second load times, Next.js App Router, React 18/19, TypeScript, and fluid GSAP/Framer micro-interactions.
- [E-Commerce & Digital Commerce](https://colver.in/services): Custom commerce engines, Indian payment rails (UPI, Razorpay, PayU), multi-currency checkout, and real-time stock sync.
- [Inventory & Operations Management](https://colver.in/services): Multi-warehouse inventory tracking, automated document data extraction pipelines, and ERP workflows.
- [AI & Workflow Automation](https://colver.in/services): Context-aware LLM agents, OCR structured document extraction, and internal operational tooling.

## Key Resources & Documentation

- [Documentation](https://colver.in/docs): Technical architecture, API integration contracts, and system capabilities.
- [Guides](https://colver.in/guides): Step-by-step implementation tutorials, keyboard shortcut palette, and performance patterns.
- [Product Showcase](https://colver.in/showcase): Interactive gallery of platforms and digital products engineered by Colver.
- [Engineering Blog](https://colver.in/blog): Research and technical insights on Core Web Vitals, sub-50ms latency, and optimistic UI updates.
- [Security & Trust Center](https://colver.in/security): Hardened HTTP edge security, Content Security Policy, HSTS preload, and vulnerability disclosure.
- [Contact Engineering](https://colver.in/contact): Submit project requirements for engineering review. Email: info@colver.in.

## Technical Specifications
- Base Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS
- Graphics & Interaction: Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion
- Edge Security: Strict Content-Security-Policy, HSTS (max-age 31536000), Permissions-Policy
